summary: Liberty Star Uranium Metals Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with 1800 Diagonal Lending LLC on June 15, 2026. Under the agreement, the company issued a convertible promissory note with a $73,700 principal amount, bearing 8% interest, a 10% original issue discount, maturing March 15, 2027. The note is convertible into common stock. This is a routine debt financing arrangement, not a special situation. No special situation category applies.
